evidence_scope: The supplied review reports inspecting a package manifest, not individual document prose. Persona responses are simulations, not human observations.
accepted: Author-first entry and traceable identity decisions
corrected_or_qualified: The existing app embeds JSON and has no runtime fetch of explorer_data.json; offline behavior must be tested rather than presumed broken.
The primary model is k=8 seed42; k=10 is an alternative with higher in-sample coherence, not the selected primary model.
The publication graph is a deterministic bipartite graph with a legend and table, not an inspected force-layout hairball.
The site already has credit and identity explanations; the revision improves their entry paths rather than inventing them from scratch.
A theme_coding or interpretation_review filename does not establish independent human coding.
No readership analytics support a most-read post claim.
The preserved before/ snapshot must remain byte-stable for reproducibility; label it through current documentation, not by renaming/editing its contents.
Licenses cannot be assigned by inference; the requester will specify them.
implementation_note: No event-first kiosk, automatic idle reset, QR destination, hosting, readership metric or human-test claim is introduced.

external_review_provenance.input: ZIP export of a previous iteration of the project
external_review_provenance.verification: Model/environment/input provenance supplied by the requester; no external session logs or exact input archive were inspected.
external_review_provenance.inspection_limit: The review document itself reports manifest/directory inspection rather than individual HTML/CSV/JSON prose. This describes its stated evidence base, not the full capabilities of the model or CAIL sandbox.
external_review_provenance.task_boundary: External model: supplied five-persona structural/heuristic critique. Codex and two Codex sub-agents: separate source-based simulations, synthesis, verification and implementation. Neither activity constitutes human user testing.

iteration_scope: Critique of the earlier ZIP export, not a fresh inspection of the current rebuilt website.
